# Smart Bill Manager

> Smart Bill Manager is an offline-first Android app for tracking recurring household bills, scanning receipts with on-device AI OCR, logging daily cash expenses, managing subscriptions, tracking personal debts, and storing product warranties — with no bank login and no cloud account required.

- Official Website: https://smart-bill-manager-web.sardar-khan299.workers.dev/
- Google Play Store (Android): https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.smartbillmanager
- Platform: Android
- Pricing Model: Freemium (free core bill tracking, cash log, warranty vault, starter offline OCR scans; optional Pro subscription with 7-day free trial or Lifetime unlock)
- Support & Privacy Contact: sardarkhan.dev@gmail.com
